load_vectors: load word vectors from a text file with optional normalization and centering
save_vectors: save word vectors and their corresponding words to a text file
procrustes: compute the orthogonal Procrustes transformation matrix between two sets of vectors
load_lexicon: load a bilingual lexicon file and map source-target word pairs to indices
compute_nn_accuracy: compute nearest neighbor accuracy for cross-lingual word vector alignment using a lexicon
